title: SB1818 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to possession of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-23; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514150834 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB1818.pdf (LegiScan doc 2899974))
provenance.note: Draft dated 2024-01-23 (as filed). No votes recorded.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307, new subsection (k)): (1) A person commits an offense who knowingly possesses a firearm or firearm ammunition, and is under indictment for a crime punishable by imprisonment for a term of one (1) year or more. (2) An offense under subdivision (k)(1) is a Class D felony.
